root_cause: Map::SummonCreature calls InitStats -> Minion::InitStats -> owner SetMinion BEFORE AddToMap/Creature::AddToWorld registration. Pet::LoadPetFromDB similarly calls SetMinion before AddToMap. The formation loop looked every GUID up through ObjectAccessor and skipped the incoming object. Hati retained default angle/distance; an existing pet's current follow generator also retained its earlier parameters. In native full-GUID order Creature8 precedes Pet10, so merely resolving the incoming object would move the primary pet's formation slot while its existing movement retained the old angle, again placing both on the same side.
repair: Build a local ordered GUID snapshot, rotate the actual GetPetGUID to the first slot, and resolve a matching incoming minion directly during apply before falling back to native ObjectAccessor. Both under-five and five-plus existing formation branches use this order. Native angle/distance formulas, ownership, pet/guardian lists, aura/credit/combat handling and primary portrait fields are preserved. No movement command/spline is restarted, no teleport, no removal/grant or hardcoded Hati entry position added.
